name: Kanzo
description: Shares one kanban board between people and coding agents: agents take tasks, move cards and comment over MCP, from a single binary.

skills.name: Agent tasks
skills.description: Takes tasks, moves cards and comments on the shared board over MCP, on behalf of the coding agent.

skills.name: Human tasks
skills.description: Marks a task as human so agents leave it to you, and filters the board to show only those tasks.
